key_insight: Linking agent memory lessons to their source evidence helps prevent failures caused by incorrect, misread, or misapplied memories.
engineering_relevance: Agent memory systems should preserve inspectable evidence alongside distilled lessons so agents can verify guidance before acting.
method: Store each concise insight with a success/failure explanation and its raw source trajectory.
Start new tasks with all insights available.
Use terminal tools to inspect linked evidence when details are missing, lessons conflict, or an insight comes from a failed task.
evidence_signal: Across five agentic benchmarks, WikiTrace consistently outperformed existing memory approaches and a same-insights-only baseline while reducing memory-induced degradation.
watch_item: Preserving and inspecting raw trajectories may add storage and inference overhead; the abstract does not quantify these costs.
paper_title: Don't Just Trust Your Memory: Evidence-Linked Memory Reduces Memory-Induced Degradation in LLM Agents
